prompt: Seen from high on the grassy mound above and beside the bunker in the first image, looking down the long slope of the downs: the shut green doors are just out of view on the left edge, with a churned tyre trail leading away from them. Lower down the slope, on the right and nearer to us, the blackened wreck of the kill bot from the second image, smoke rising off it, a crow on the turret. The little grey robot from the third image is rolling down the trail, amber beacon lit, bunting trailing, passing to the left of the wreck. Empty downland to the horizon, flat grey light. Shot like a 1980s BBC drama on 16mm stock, washed-out colour, gentle contrast, thick grain. Widescreen, no lettering.
